title: How to Use Your Personate Credits Strategically: A beginner's Guide | Personate

facts.fact: Personate's Starter plan includes 500 credits for $9, which the vendor states is about $0.018 per credit.
Personate's Creator plan includes 1,800 credits for $59, which the vendor states is about $0.033 per credit.
Personate's Professional plan includes 4,400 credits for $149, which the vendor states is about $0.034 per credit.
Voice cloning on Personate costs 100 credits as a one-time setup.
Voice cloning on Personate is reusable for an unlimited number of videos, according to the vendor.
Video-to-avatar creation on Personate costs 100 credits per avatar as a one-time setup.
facts.quote: Cost: 100 credits per avatar, one time

facts.fact: Photo-to-avatar creation on Personate costs 600 credits per avatar as a one-time setup.
facts.quote: Cost: 600 credits per avatar, one time

facts.fact: Avatar video generation on Personate uses 1 credit per second of video.
facts.quote: Avatar video generation uses 1 credit per second

facts.fact: AI image generation on Personate uses 1 credit per image.
facts.quote: AI image generation uses 1 credit per image

facts.fact: Prompt-to-video generation on Personate uses 17 credits per second of output.

facts.fact: Voice generation on Personate costs 0.15 credits per second of audio.
